programme.title: PL STORIES
programme.desc: We dive into the fiercest rivalry in English football-Manchester United and Liverpool. As Liverpool draw level with United's record haul of top-flight titles, this is a story of history, pride, and the relentless pursuit of greatness. With insight from icons on both sides-Ian Rush, Lou Macari, Brian Kidd, Michael Owen, Phil Thompson, and new Liverpool boss Arne Slot, we unpack the moments that have defined generations, split families, and lit up the Premier League.

programme.title: One Friday Fight - 118
programme.desc: Don't miss ONE Friday Fights 118 as the world's largest martial arts organization brings MMA, kickboxing, and Muay Thai back to Bangkok. In the main event, Worapon aims to extend his win streak in a rubber match against Turkey's Soner Sen. Plus, British rising star Otis Waghorn takes on French-Moroccan sensation Hakim Bah, who has won his last seven fights!

programme.title: Main Race - F1 Belgian Grand Prix - 2025
programme.desc: beIN SPORTS is the live and exclusive broadcast partners of Formula 1 until end of 2033 season. The 2025 season has a record schedule of 24 Formula 1 races and all race weekends, including every Practice, Qualifying, Sprint & Race will be live & exclusive on beIN.

programme.title: Manchester City vs Crystal Palace- English Premier League 2024/2025
programme.desc: Man City have lost just one of their last 12 Premier League games against Crystal Palace, going down 2-0 at home in October 2021. Having lost each of their first six Premier League visits to the Etihad Stadium, Crystal Palace have lost just two of their last six away to Man City in the competition.

programme.title: Manchester United vs Liverpool English Premier League 2024/2025
programme.desc: Manchester United have won just one of their last 12 Premier League meetings with Liverpool, beating them 2-1 at Old Trafford in their third game of the 2022-23 campaign. Liverpool have lost just one of their last six Premier League away games against Manchester United, while only Manchester City have won away at Old Trafford more often than the Reds in the competition’s history.

programme.title: Everton vs Liverpool - English Premier League 2024/2025
programme.desc: Everton won 2-0 in their last Premier League game against Liverpool in April 2024, last winning consecutive league Merseyside derbies in the 1984-85 campaign. Liverpool’s 2-0 loss in this exact fixture last season ended a 12-game unbeaten away run in the Premier League against Everton. They’ve not lost consecutive visits to Goodison Park since a run of three between 1992 and 1994.

Worn by a Mohamed Salah at the top of his art since the arrival of Arne Slot with 25 goals and 17 assists in all competitions, a duo Ibrahima Konaté - Virgil Van Dijk impassable defensively or even a Dominik Szoboszlai who feasts on his new role as number 10, the Reds have all the cards in hand to overthrow the situation and defend their title and defend Newcastle against Spurs who count on the great first in central defense of the former Lensois, Kevin Danso, the immense talent of Mathys Tel, loaned by Bayern Munich, and the magical left foot of Dejan Kulusevski to snatch their ticket for the League Cup final and save a very disappointing season.

programme.title: The film of the UBB season: Sacred Union

programme.title: Villarreal / Real Madrid
programme.desc: Less than 72 hours after its qualification for the quarterfinals of the Champions League, Real Madrid (2nd) must quickly get back into the Liga bath with a complicated trip to Villarreal (5th), still well placed in the C1 race. The Merengues are counting on a revanchard vinicius after its missed penalty against Atlético de Madrid, ready to prove its value. Aurélien Tchouameni, who has become essential in the midfield, plays a key role in the structure of Carlo Ancelotti's game. Finally, Kylian Mbappé, in search of his 30th goal under the Madrid colors, is more motivated than ever to extend his series. With these assets, Real hopes to start from the Estadio de la Cerámica with the three points and temporarily take the head of the Liga. For his part, Villarreal is betting on the experience of Dani Parejo to orchestrate the game in the middle, while the former Newcastle player, Ayoze Pérez, author of 11 goals this season, and the magic winger Nicolas Pépé, will be offensive weapons ...

programme.title: FC Porto / Benfica Lisbonne
programme.desc: In a Estádio Do Dragão ready to vibrate, Benfica, 2nd in the ranking, moves for a boiling clasico against FC Porto, 3rd, with a single goal in mind: to continue its frantic quest for the title. Assated with Sporting, the Eagles are based on the essential Angel Di Maria, still as magical at 37 years old, as well as on a Kerem Aktürkoğlu, in full confidence after his double against Farense. Vangélis Pavlídis, in a real finisher, completes a formidable offensive trio, determined to win a 9th consecutive success. For their part, the dragons, determined to stop their sworn enemy, count on the Vista of Samu Aghehowa, 2nd top scorer in the championship, and on the young nugget Rodrigo Mora, to create the surprise and put Benfica back in his place. A clasico where the tension will be maximum, with a major issue: the national title.

programme.title: Real Madrid / Leganes

Logic is leaning in favor of Madrilenians, but legally, despite its precarious position, is not to be underestimated. programme.title: Grand Prix of the City of Dinard
programme.desc: Dissemination of Dinard's international Jumping, a prestigious hippic competition that appeared in 1912. He was classified in the category of international competitions in 1960, allowing him to host competitions such as European championships.

programme.title: The dream of a life
programme.desc: In 2025, Serbian Novak Djokovic is preparing to play Wimbledon for the 20th time. His childhood dream was to lift the trophy, he will achieve it 7 times. programme.title: Tours / Poitiers
programme.desc: Last act, last breath: the TVB is about to live an evening with a history on Saturday in Grenon, against Poitiers. Winner at the first leg (3-1), Tours has a golden opportunity to win a 10th title of champion of France, which would propel him at the height of AS Cannes at the top of the hexagonal volleyball. But a derby does not obey any logic. Poitiers, heckled but far from being killed, knows that it would be a victory, four daring sets, to write his own legend. The feat of Nantes last year, who came to impose themselves in the gold set, feeds their hopes. The Alterna will count on Nik Mujanovic, in search of a last shine under the pepper colors before joining the TVB this summer. At the end of the road: Europe and the Champions League. But for Tours, it is also the culmination of a forged season in the fight. From Luca Ramon to Ryan Sclater, all want to write the perfect epilogue under the leadership of Marcelo Fronckowiak and engrave their name in the marble of Grenon.
